summary: Propose function_definitions.csv rows for the 58 CM550 functions that still show stack-argument pieces, then a skeptic checks each row against the ROM

functions.name: cm550_FUN_0000b688
evidence: ROM 0xb688: move.l d2;-(sp) then move.w (8;sp);d2 = the word at +4; only its low byte is used (cmpi.b #0x41 / cmpi.b #0x4e / cmp.b 4 / 5 / 25 / move.b d2;d0 as the table index)

1 call site: cm550_diagnosticMultiPacketResponseBuilder 0x3217e pushes move.w d0;-(sp) with d0 = the request's first data byte (movea.l (6;a3);a0 / move.b (a0);d0); after the call move.b d0;d3 is the bound of its byte copy loop - so D0 is used (byte return row)

Same code as CM848 cm848_getJ1939DiagnosticResponseEchoLength (0x204a8): 4/5 -> 3 / 0x19 -> 5 / 0x41-0x4e -> table / else 1; ROM 0xb67a-0xb687 = 03 03 03 03 03 05 05 07 07 05 05 05 05 03 - a shared-name rename lead

rows.name: diagnostic_service
rows.comment: The PGN 61184 diagnostic service byte - the word at +4 (move.w (8;sp) after move.l d2); only its low byte is compared (cmpi.b #0x41 / #0x4e - 4 / 5 / 0x19); the one caller cm550_diagnosticMultiPacketResponseBuilder pushes the request's first data byte (movea.l (6;a3);a0 / move.b (a0);d0 / move.w d0;-(sp)) - the same code as CM848 cm848_getJ1939DiagnosticResponseEchoLength (PR #53 round 86)

How many request bytes the response repeats: 3 for services 4 / 5 - 5 for 0x19 - the byte at 0xb639 + service for 0x41-0x4e (03 03 03 03 03 05 05 07 07 05 05 05 05 03 at 0xb67a) - else 1; the caller uses it as its copy count (move.b d0;d3) (PR #53 round 86)

functions.name: cm550_modeBasedDataDispatcher
evidence: ROM 0xc80e: movem.l of 3 registers then move.w (16;sp);d2 = the word at +4; cmpi.b #1 / #3 / #5 on its low byte select jsr 0x4025c+0x4057e / 0x4073e / 0x40890+0x408f6 (undumped code) with *(0x8000f0) + 0x10 / 0x30 / 0x50
RAM dump 0x8000f0 = 0xffc800 = the chip select 5 82527 base - so the argument is the message object number (object n registers at 0xffc800 + n * 0x10)

1 call site: cm550_modeBasedDataDispatcherWrapper 0x1e1c6 (move.w d0;-(sp) / addq.l #2;sp / rts); mc68k_canCs5InterruptHandler 0x1e216 calls the wrapper with interrupt code - 2 (addi.b #0xfe) when Control0 bit 5 is clear (btst #5;(a2)) and ignores D0 afterwards - no return row

Lead: the CS5 wrappers 0x1e1be (receive - calls this) and 0x1e1ac (transmit - calls the stub 0xc80c) each read their own word at +4 (move.w (4;sp);d1 / move.b d1;d0) but render (void): they need a message_object ushort row too or the wrapper's call may show an in_stack token after this row applies; the name modeBasedDataDispatcher misreads a CAN receive message object dispatcher

rows.name: message_object
rows.comment: The 82527 message object number - the word at +4 (move.w (16;sp) after a movem of 3 registers); its low byte picks the handler (cmpi.b #1 / #3 / #5 -> 0x4057e / 0x4073e / 0x408f6 with *(0x8000f0) + object * 0x10 - 0xffc800 in the RAM dump - the chip select 5 controller); cm550_modeBasedDataDispatcherWrapper pushes its own argument's low byte (move.b d1;d0 / move.w d0;-(sp)) - mc68k_canCs5InterruptHandler's interrupt code - 2 for an object whose Control0 bit 5 is clear; no caller reads D0 (PR #53 round 86)

functions.name: cm550_diagnosticStatus2Initializer
evidence: ROM 0xd1a4: no prologue push; cmpi.w #2;(4;sp) is the only stack read (the word at +4)
1 call site: cm550_engine_protection_coordinator 0x345a4: move.w (0x80ded4).l;d2 / clr.w (0x80ded4).l / ... / move.w d2;-(sp) / jsr 0xd1a4 / bsr.b 0x34564 - D0 ignored so no return row

The coordinator is the FSDSFLST (user fueling state) selector chain: 0xd18a claims 0x1e / 0xd1a4 claims 2 / 0x34564 claims 5 / 0xd4ae claims 7 / 0x1c630 defaults to 8 - each only while FSDSFLST is 0 - CM848's FUELING_STATE numbering; the argument is the state the last pass left (so != 2 means entering state 2 - the all-speed governor preset)

rows.name: previous_user_fueling_state
rows.comment: FSDSFLST (0x80ded4) as the last pass left it - the word at +4 (cmpi.w #2;(4;sp)); cm550_engine_protection_coordinator saves FSDSFLST in d2 / clears it / pushes d2 (move.w d2;-(sp)) before this selector; when it claims state 2 (0x80a98e is 2) from any other state it presets the all-speed governor terms; the caller ignores D0 (PR #53 round 86)

functions.name: cm550_retarderModeThresholdCalculator

functions.name: cm550_FUN_0001192a
